scope: complete first-current g^2*hbar^3 coefficient with arbitrary quartic W tensor and arbitrary representations; all input and output color indices open
spectator: gamma5 is a free gauge singlet and all of its source is retained

representation_words.MM: ordered products of t_A,t_B on the stated W legs
representation_words.fR: i*C^C_AB*t_C on the stated W leg
representation_words.matrix_orientation: the external matter index is the row; the original W index is the column

source_polynomial_proof.bound: rank at most three for the spectator-source block of the bare current determinant, plus one inserted current
source_polynomial_proof.restoration: det(M)^3*M, then polynomial continuation to dependent sources
